contract.atomicFactSet: Libra在唯一Primary的正式Probe成功后，按current active Run/state revision/execution basis、正式resolved_identity及active同Run Workspace原子冻结UsAdultCatalogueAnalysisBasis；只写libra_us_adult_catalogue_bases，不预读/冻结People库；同Run相同完整Basis重放，不同来源/模型/目录/策略拒绝，插入中断全回滚；历史读取/幂等重放不授予执行资格，执行读取须重核active Run、相同execution basis/身份及active Workspace，单纯priority revision变化不重写Basis；不创建Event/Effect/Outbox，不写People/Arca
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: active Run/state/execution basis, identity and Workspace fences; Basis insert; before and after COMMIT; concurrent freeze and delayed execution reads
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Exactly one complete immutable catalogue Basis; injected failure rolls back; immutable replay is separate from live execution authority; no People or execution writes
